main_text.l: qui testimonium falsum dixissent, eo-rumque facultates publicasse. Quod ve-rò his præmittit, eosdem Lycios rapinis & latrociniis victum quæritasse, id cum Strabone haudquaquàm convenit, cu-fides[?] major tribuenda.

page.notes: The printer's woodcut ornament (a device with a grotesque face in a scroll, with hanging motifs above and a small lower motif) stands below "FINIS." and is not transcribed. The word "fides" at the line break in "cu-fides" is printed with a long-s-like form in the scan; read as "fides" but marked [?]. The right-hand page shows only its edge (partial text fragments and show-through), which is not transcribed. The lower part of the page shows faint show-through from the reverse and is disregarded.
